lines.en: She's not as pretty as she was when she was 29.
- Miss Green would like to establish some ground rules
She would appreciate it if you didn't use the words
or "they still look pretty damn good."
They all came from the list you handed out to us two weeks ago.
Well, can I keep the presents and still be 29?
Look, turning 30's not that big a deal.
Is that how you felt when you turned 30?
